details:
The game opens normally, but in the first 30 seconds of it being open it only shows the background (no music) and my controllers, after that it shows the “logging in via meta as [username]” message and right as it finishes logging in the game completely freezes for a while, when it unfreezes it takes around 10-15 minutes to go from a black screen (I assume it’s the black screen before the “loading world” screen) to the joining instance screen where it freezes again, after loading the default home it immediately disconnects me from the world saying “cannot join instance” and it freezes for about 4 minutes, after clicking “ok” my home world tries to load only to do the same thing, after that the default home reloads and it does let me in but every 2-4 minutes the game freezes over and over again (every freeze frame lasts about 3-5 minutes), I've tried to open the game with a second headset (Quesr 2) that I have and the same thing happens, I'm in Mexico, in case this might be a regional issue since my partner who's in the US atm doesn't experience this.

I have videos showing most of the issue (the black screen section wasn't recorded)

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12NY_aC0rd0S9ZjmrSIfNmQbs4jjFqKJ0?usp=sharing
title: Game keeps freezing and it takes forever to log in
